provenance.quantity: Scenario quantity, not observed farmer quantity; set to 1 quintal for scale-normalized simulations.
provenance.storage_rates: Retained from legacy decision_support.py constants and interpreted as scenario INR/kg/month; not measured farmer or warehouse invoices.
provenance.spoilage_rates: Retained from legacy decision_support.py constants and applied once as total loss over the evaluated holding decision; temporal calibration is unavailable.
provenance.transport_cost: Zero because the retrospective forecast artifact does not contain a validated route-specific transport quote; zero is a scenario assumption, not an observed cost.
provenance.duration: Forecast horizon quarters converted to months using three months per quarter; scenario duration only.
